integrity: All-parameter statements follow from explicit algebra and inequalities. The numerical checks are finite diagnostics only. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only continuous-time unnormalized weighted-Laplacian heat on a four-cycle with one varying jump conductance and a fixed unit-edge graph metric; not normalized heat, variable distance lengths, larger cycles, or multi-edge perturbations.
title: Exact Lipschitz heat profile and a sharp fast-edge threshold on the four-cycle
